$comment: Ground truth for SECOND WORLD recall/precision (docs/12-testing-and-quality.md §3). location.line = the line after the SEEDED-DEFECT marker; refresh with `node examples/_tools/sync-expected-findings.mjs examples/shop-fastify`. Reproduced by tests/integration/examples/shop-fastify.test.ts. `correctByDesign` lists behaviours that are implemented correctly here and must NOT be reported (precision). location.symbol = enclosing exported function; location.handler = route whose handler contains the defect; location.callee = the offending call.

defects.title: Product search does a full scan with one query per product
defects.fix: Use the inverted index (db.searchIndexed) — enabled by FIXED=1

defects.title: Retries to payments use a constant 50 ms delay without jitter (synchronised retry storm)
defects.reproduction: payments failNext=3 -> attempt gaps are all ~50 ms (constant, identical across clients)

defects.title: No circuit breaker: a failing payments provider is called 4x on every order forever
defects.reproduction: payments failPct=100; 5 orders -> 20 attempts (no short-circuit after repeated failures)
defects.fix: Open a breaker after N consecutive failures; fail fast with 503 while open

defects.title: 500 on boundary page size (limit=0 or negative) instead of 400
defects.fix: Validate 1 <= limit <= 100 with a Fastify querystring schema

defects.title: Broken function-level authorization: customers can DELETE /products/:id (admin-only)
readFileSync on every GET /terms request
defects.reproduction: Static: fs.readFileSync call inside a route handler
defects.fix: Read once at startup or use fs.promises

defects.title: Schema drift: GET /orders/:id returns createdAt as a number (contract: date-time string)
defects.reproduction: Create an order, GET /orders/<id> -> createdAt is epoch millis

defects.title: Concurrent POST /orders with the same Idempotency-Key each create an order
defects.description: DISCOVERED, not planted: found by the Adversarial Test Agent (idempotency-concurrent technique) and kept as ground truth. The key lookup -> await (stock, payment) -> insert sequence is not atomic; sequential repeats ARE replayed correctly (see correctByDesign idempotency-honoured).
defects.reproduction: Send 5 concurrent POST /orders with one Idempotency-Key -> more than one distinct order id
defects.fix: Make key reservation atomic: insert the key (unique) before doing the work, or a per-key lock; concurrent duplicates wait for and replay the first response

correctByDesign.note: Sequential repeats with the same Idempotency-Key return the original order. Concurrent duplicates are NOT handled: known discovered defect idempotency-key-race.
